question: Which city did PM Modi and President Macron visit to inaugurate a new Indian consulate in February 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Marseille**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marseille** is a significant port city located in **southern France** along the Mediterranean coast.
 
• It is the **second-largest city in France** after Paris and is known for its rich history, vibrant culture, and diverse population.
 
• The city holds strategic importance due to its position as one of the largest commercial ports in the **Mediterranean region**, facilitating trade and commerce.
 
• The inauguration of the new Indian consulate in Marseille highlights the strengthening of **India-France diplomatic relations**, emphasizing the importance of cultural and economic cooperation.
 
• This move aligns with India's efforts to enhance its presence and connectivity in Europe by establishing consulates in key cities.
 
• Marseille's multicultural environment and economic significance make it an ideal location for an Indian consulate, fostering **bilateral trade, tourism, and cultural exchanges**.
 
• The event reflects the commitment of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **President Emmanuel Macron** to deepen ties between India and France.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Baku**__

 __
 
• **Baku** is the capital city of **Azerbaijan**, located along the Caspian Sea.
 
• It is known for its **modern architecture**, historical landmarks, and energy sector.
 
• Baku is a major hub for oil and gas production, contributing to Azerbaijan's economy.
 
 
 
• **Lyon**__
 __
 
• **Lyon** is a city in central France known for its **gastronomy** and historical heritage.
 
• The city is recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site due to its well-preserved architecture and cultural importance.
 
• Lyon is also a prominent center for **banking, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries**.
 
 
 
• **Toulouse**__
 
 
• **Toulouse** is located in southern France and is known as the **aerospace capital of Europe**.
 
• The city hosts major aerospace companies like **Airbus**, making it a hub for innovation and technology.
 
• Toulouse also has a rich history and is famous for its unique **pink terracotta architecture**.
